KPI: OBJ-01| Fit/style confidence sessions meeting charter criterion
Target: ≥ 80% of eligible try-on sessions show fit AND style confidence gain ≥ +1 point OR post ≥ 4/5, AND rate the fit visualization "like" (≥ 4/5) (Charter §3.2 OBJ-01 / Scope Criterion 9)
Evidence reference: Pre/post fit_confidence + style_confidence answers joined to fit_visualization in-app ratings (FR-7.5 / KAN-89 / KAN-101). No eligible sessions captured yet.

KPI: OBJ-02| Guest first try-on ≤ 2 min with zero photo uploads
Target: First-time Guest completes one virtual try-on ≤ 2:00 without training, registration, or any photo upload (Charter §3.2 OBJ-02 / Scope Criterion 6)
Evidence reference: Observed UAT session timing + upload audit (KAN-88 / UAT-01). Observed measurement — subjective ratings are NOT accepted as a substitute.

KPI: OBJ-03| Performance (API < 500 ms / canvas < 1 s / load < 3 s)
Target: 95% of catalog/filtering/recommendation/commerce API requests < 500 ms; canvas overlay/view/proportion renders < 1 s; initial load < 3 s (Charter §3.2 OBJ-03 / Scope Criteria 1–3)
Evidence reference: Automated performance run + canvas render benchmark + load-time test (KAN-84 / KAN-90; measure_api_perf). Measured values only.

Target: 100% pass on Security & Privacy checklist (TLS 1.2+, Argon2id, server-side RBAC, ephemeral guests, no photo upload) (Charter §3.2 OBJ-04 / RT-09)
Evidence reference: Security & Privacy checklist audit (KAN-90 / RT-09 / UAT-07).

Target: ≥ 80% of recorded Recommendation-Panel ratings approve the recommendation ("like" or score ≥ 4/5) (Charter §3.2 OBJ-05 / Scope Criterion 10)
Evidence reference: Rating rows with source=recommendation_panel (FR-7.5 / KAN-101). Approval = vote "like" or score ≥ 4/5. No ratings recorded yet.

KPI: OBJ-06| Purchase-decision sessions meeting charter criterion
Target: ≥ 80% of eligible sessions report purchase-decision confidence increase AND return-intent decrease versus the pre-session baseline (Charter §3.2 OBJ-06 / Scope Criterion 11)
Evidence reference: Paired pre/post purchase_confidence and return_intent responses (KAN-89). Session passes only when confidence strictly increased AND return intent strictly decreased. No eligible sessions captured yet.

KPI: OBJ-07| Mock checkout completion (completed ÷ created carts)
Target: ≥ 70% of carts created during UAT complete the simulated mock checkout (Charter §3.2 OBJ-07 / Scope Criterion 8)
Evidence reference: Server-side UAT commerce events (cart_created / checkout_completed) recorded on active shopper UAT sessions (KAN-89). No UAT carts recorded yet.

Target: 10-item CSV upload pipeline completes < 60 s (Charter §3.2 OBJ-08)
Evidence reference: `python manage.py measure_upload` timing run (KAN-83 / KAN-84), budget < 60 s.

KPI: OBJ-09| Items published without manual correction
Target: ≥ 80% of CSV-uploaded items publish without manual correction (Charter §3.2 OBJ-09 / Scope Criterion 5)
Evidence reference: Seller Dashboard validation-report audit — items published without manual correction (KAN-85 / UAT-05).
